crossRefs.note: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
translations.bsb: “I have no husband,” the woman replied. Jesus said to her, “You are correct to say that you have no husband.
translations.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
translations.asv: The woman answered and said unto him, I have no husband. Jesus saith unto her, Thou saidst well, I have no husband:
